Step2 low true high true -> high -> false ✓
Step3 middle -> qFill false -> false ✓
Step4 low false -> true ✓

fault_inhibit: step0 low true high false -> middle, qFill false -> false ✓
step1 low false high true -> fault true, fill false ✓
step2 low false high false -> fill true ✓ (qFill becomes true)
step3 low true high false inhibit true -> inhibit -> false ✓
step4 low true high false inhibit false -> middle, qFill=false -> false ✓

All good. Also LTL: P3 requires Fill when !LowWet&!HighWet&!Inhibit — guaranteed by ELSIF NOT LowWet. But note HighWet false, LowWet false means not fault, so ordering fine.
